headline: Roth Capital Reiterates Buy on Snap-on, Raises Price Target to $461
summary: Roth Capital  analyst Scott Stember   reiterates Snap-on (NYSE:SNA) with a Buy and raises the price target from $409 to $461.

headline: Snap-On Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
summary: Snap-On (NYSE:SNA) reported higher second-quarter sales and earnings, with management pointing to strength in its Commercial & Industrial business and continued demand from vehicle repair technicians despite what executives described as a highly uncertain operating environment.
